en.html:
I knew this sight.
How would I not know it?

Day after day I had watched it.

Let her recover, I had wished. Let this sight not be here tomorrow.
Let nothing terrible happen, I had wished. Let this sight still be here tomorrow.

Both wishes pulling opposite ways, and I had held on to both.
For one whole year, I had watched.

Her, like this.

Hikaru—mineral poisoning ruining her body and her mind!
